introduction: This video is part one of a three-part series on the history of Napoleon. Here, we cover the period

vocabulary.example: The sovereignty of the island was ceded to France.

vocabulary.definition: people who rise in active revolt against an authority or government
vocabulary.example: In Paris, insurgents take over the royal fortress of Bastille.

vocabulary.definition: to be executed by a machine designed to behead a person
vocabulary.example: Louis XVI is then tried and guillotined, further angering European monarchies.

vocabulary.definition: enlistment of people for military service
vocabulary.example: On the French side, conscriptions swell up the ranks of the army.

vocabulary.definition: the action of annexing something, especially territory
vocabulary.example: He obtains the annexation of the Austrian Netherlands.

vocabulary.definition: a person or state that intervenes, especially militarily, in the affairs of another state
vocabulary.example: Napoleon continues with his interventionist policy by redrawing boundaries at will.
